title: Franchise Crossovers Overview
body:
This public edition is a pairing index for the twelve franchise pairs in this lane. Each pairing guide below compares two franchises in factual terms — their media forms, their themes and their audiences — and explains how a reader or viewer can compare them.

No pairing guide claims that an official crossover work exists unless it says so in plain factual terms, and none reproduces copyrighted text. The Signature companion edition contains the actual crossover stories, all labeled unofficial original fiction.

The twelve franchise pairs indexed here are: Harry Potter, Star Wars, Star Trek, The Lord of the Rings, Marvel, DC, Pokémon, Super Mario, Minecraft, The Witcher, Doctor Who, Sherlock Holmes.

print("Franchise Crossovers | public pairing index")
print("Pairings: 11")

Pairings: 11

title: Harry Potter meets Star Wars: Pairing Guide
body:
Pairing guide: a school of magic meets a starship crew. In factual terms, Harry Potter and Star Wars are both long-running franchises with books, screen and game entries in their public records, and both are organized in this lane as their own public-plus-Signature database pairs.

What the two franchises share in form is a large cast, a developed setting and a long publication history that rewards reading or viewing in order. What differs is their medium history and tone, and this guide's comparison stops at those public, structural facts rather than inventing shared story events.

For the fictional meeting of these worlds, see the Signature crossover story of the same pairing in the companion Signature edition, labeled unofficial throughout.

print("Theme: a school of magic meets a starship crew")
